recon.control_definition: Control - no Zn or Fe application
recon.treatment_definition: Various Zn treatments: 1) Foliar 0.5% ZnSO4, 2) Soil 10 kg Zn ha-1, 3) Combined foliar 0.5% ZnSO4 + 1% FeSO4, 4) Combined soil 10 kg Zn ha-1 + 12 kg Fe ha-1
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Fe-only treatments (foliar 1% FeSO4, soil 12 kg Fe ha-1) should NOT be extracted as these contain no Zn
recon.sample_size_source: Randomized complete block design (RCBD) under factorial was used with three replications
recon.extraction_guidance: PRIMARY OUTCOME (grain Zn concentration) is in Figure 3b only, not in tables. Extract Zn treatments vs control: 1) Foliar 0.5% ZnSO4 vs Control, 2) Soil 10 kg Zn ha-1 vs Control, 3) Combined foliar Zn+Fe vs Control, 4) Combined soil Zn+Fe vs Control. Extract both years separately (2016-17 and 2017-18). Do NOT extract Fe-only treatments. Figure shows individual year data points, not means across years. Use LSD values from tables as variance measure if available for figure data.
